text:
Jordan Eberle is 36, the Kraken captain and one of the few players who has been in Seattle since the start, with 381 games for the franchise. He is still doing the job they need most: eight of his 13 points have come on the power play, including a tipped-in goal against Vancouver last week.

His finishing is honest, six goals on 6.33 expected and shooting 14.3%, right where our range expects. The concern is at five-on-five, where Seattle has taken only 44.7% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice. That is roughly the team's level without him too, so it reads more like a Kraken problem than an Eberle one, but it does keep his even-strength scoring quiet.

The minutes have settled at 16:32 a night, and his last ten games brought six points. Evolving-Hockey rated him 1.0 win above replacement in 2025-26, a useful middle-six forward. With 334 career goals before this season, the long road from Regina, Edmonton and Long Island is still adding chapters. Our numbers project 53 points, with a range of 43 to 64.
headline: Eberle, at 36, still earns his power-play time
